_doc: The strategy book. One bet = one lever, judged on one metric against the baseline it opened at. Verdicts come from pipeline/scoreboard.py. Status: open, won, stopped, no-edge, watch. Rules in docs/strategy.md.

campaign.name: Stage 2: Make it travel
campaign.goal: reels that get forwarded and reach well beyond our followers
campaign._note: Targets as written in docs/strategy.md (Stage 2 dates agreed by Akhilesh 2026-10-04). Raising followers to 1,200 and adding a strategy stop were put to Akhilesh on 2026-11-01; until he answers, no strategy stop is set for this stage.

bets.name: Hook in frame one
bets.lever: Frame 1: the anchor looks into the lens, already saying the viewer's stake; the hook in 6 big words or fewer on screen; nothing (Namaskar, title, logo) before it; a cut or punch-in by 1 s; cover = frame 1
bets.thesis: 54-67% skipped in the first 3 s: E2 opened on Sarika looking down with no hook text, E1 on a teleshop set with no stake

bets.name: Tight 20-30 s
bets.lever: 20-30 s total; title montage 1.5 s or less and only after the hook; payoff by 20 s; the last line echoes the hook so a replay feels natural; no dead air
bets.thesis: The 56 s and 33 s reels were watched about 25% of the way; shorter and tighter should lift completion, which Instagram ranks on
bets.result: Closed as no edge, starved: 1 judged reel in 36 days (E3, 38.6% watched); the six breakouts since 9 Oct ran 57-92 s. Akhilesh's 30 s rule in CLAUDE.md stands as a writing rule; it is no longer traded as a bet. Reopen as a new bet if owner data shows long reels watched under 20% while 30 s reels sit above 35%.

bets.name: A line worth sending
bets.lever: Every script lands one line a viewer would forward to a specific person (a number to remember, a jab at the system, an 'I told you so'); never ask for shares
bets.thesis: Sends per reach is the signal Instagram weighs most for reaching non-followers; the comedy reel got the only send so far

bets.name: Split-screen opener
bets.lever: Frame one is a split screen: the story's picture, logo, real footage or B-roll on the top half with the hook in 6 words or fewer (the number or the known name), our presenter on the bottom half; from the very first frame; the cover is frame one
bets.thesis: Every split-screen opener so far broke out: E11 Starlink vs Jio 4,091 at 72 h, E13 eMudhra 5,865, E14 silver 2,171, E15 Anthropic 12,564. The two news reels since without one stayed low: X3 F&O 562, EPFO (X4+X5) 589. 4 of 10 Indian money outliers this week used it, 6 of 10 last week, 8 of 10 the week before. Confounded with topic, so judged on 4 reels, all news of the day

bets.name: Glam Sarika
bets.lever: Sarika in the glam wardrobe (formats/samachar.md) on every Samachar reel
bets.thesis: Akhilesh: a glamorous anchor is a hook for this audience. Confounded with B1 on skip rate while both run, so it is compared with the other formats at the monthly review

bets.name: Famous name in frame one
bets.applies: reels whose frame one names or shows a company, brand or person every viewer knows
bets.lever: Frame one shows a company, brand or person every viewer already knows (their name, logo, or a licensed photo or real footage), with the number or question it turns on
bets.thesis: All four reels that opened on a known name (Policybazaar, Snapdeal/Kunal Bahl, HUL, Nana Patekar) reached 582-3,224 plays; all eight that didn't stayed at 94-303. Their skip rates (54-64%) were no better, so it works through distribution, not the opening. Confounded with topic choice, so tracked, not traded

previous_campaigns.name: Stage 1: Stop the scroll
previous_campaigns.goal: prove people stop for our reels and stay to the end

stop.means: The current strategy isn't stopping the scroll. Check Account Status and the AI-profile label first (a restricted account looks exactly like this), then the Sunday review brings 2-3 alternative strategies, each with its own target and stop, for Akhilesh to pick. No more tweaking the same approach.

previous_campaigns.result: Closed 2026-11-01 (monthly review). Hit: best reel 12,564 (target 2,000), followers 709 (target 100), median plays at 72 h 582 (target 500). Unknown since 9 Oct (owner feed down): skip 56% and watched 29.3% at the last reading, both short of 45. Strategy stop not hit (18 reels, median 582 vs 300).
